guide.greenlantern.title: Corps Manual
guide.greenlantern.welcome.title: Welcome
guide.greenlantern.welcome:
You have been chosen! This manual teaches everything a new Green Lantern needs to know.

§aFirst steps§r
1. Craft a §2Power Ring§r (diamond + emeralds).
2. Craft a §2Power Battery§r and place it.
3. Click the battery with the ring in hand to charge it: a new ring comes empty.
4. Right-click with the ring (or press §eG§r) to put on the uniform.
5. Double-tap jump to fly and hold §eR§r to pick a construct.

Use the chapters on the left, the ◀ ▶ arrows below or the mouse wheel to navigate. Recipes are in the Recipes chapter.
guide.greenlantern.ring.title: Power Ring
guide.greenlantern.ring:
The ring is the source of all your powers: the uniform, flight and hard-light constructs.

§aEnergy§r
The ring stores up to 5000 energy. The bar shows on the item, in its tooltip and on the HUD in the top-left corner. Every construct costs energy to create, and some drain a little per second while they exist. Flying drains energy too, and the faster you fly, the more it costs.

When energy is low the HUD blinks red. With no energy left the uniform fades and constructs vanish.

§aUse§r
Without the uniform, right-click puts it on. With the uniform, right-click uses the selected construct.

The ring doesn't burn in lava or fire.
guide.greenlantern.battery.title: Power Battery
guide.greenlantern.battery:
The Power Battery is the lantern that recharges your ring.

§aCharging§r
Place the battery, hold the ring and right-click it. Energy flows from the lantern into the ring while you stay close, and the Corps oath appears on screen. Click again to stop.

You hear a chime when the ring is full. If you walk too far away, charging stops.

Take a battery on your travels: it can be mined with a pickaxe and placed again anywhere.
guide.greenlantern.uniform.title: Uniform
guide.greenlantern.uniform:
With the ring in hand, right-click or press §eG§r to put on the Corps uniform: hard-light mask, suit, leggings and boots.

§aProtection§r
The uniform protects like diamond armor. You need it to fly and to use constructs.

§aYour armor is kept safe§r
When you put the uniform on, the armor you were wearing is stored. Press §eG§r again to remove the uniform and you get it back.

Uniform pieces can't be taken off in the inventory or dropped.
guide.greenlantern.flight.title: Power flight
guide.greenlantern.flight:
With the uniform on, §edouble-tap jump§r to take off (or stop flying). Near the ground, take-off releases a burst of energy.

§aSpeed§r
Hold §eW§r and your speed keeps growing. With §eCtrl§r (sprint) it grows faster. After a few seconds you break the §asound barrier§r: sonic boom, vapor rings and "SUPERSONIC" on the HUD. You fly where you look.

§aManeuvers§r
• Double-tap §eA§r or §eD§r at high speed: barrel roll.
• Hold §eS§r at high speed: air brake.
• Dive into the ground fast: hero landing, a shockwave that throws nearby creatures (you take no damage).

Hitting a wall head-on at speed kills your momentum. The ring protects you from fall damage.
guide.greenlantern.constructs.title: Constructs
guide.greenlantern.constructs:
Constructs are hard-light objects created by your willpower.

§aPicking one§r
Hold §eR§r to open the construct wheel: point with the mouse and release (or click). On the wheel, keys §e1-8§r and the mouse wheel work too. A quick tap on §eR§r picks the next one, and §eShift + mouse wheel§r with the ring in hand also switches.

§a1. Energy Blast§r: click to launch a sphere that explodes on impact without breaking blocks.

§a2. Minigun§r: hold right-click for a continuous burst.

§a3. Protection Bubble§r: click to toggle. Absorbs most damage, pushes creatures away and reflects projectiles. Drains energy per second.

§a4. Giant Saw§r: a vehicle with a circular saw in front. Shreds creatures and cuts trees, leaves and plants. §eW/S§r drive, §eA/D§r strafe, the mouse steers, jump hops and sneak gets off.

§a5. Giant Hammer§r: a hammer appears where you look and slams the ground with a shockwave.

§a6. Giant Drill§r: a vehicle that bores and mines. See its chapter.

§a7. Giant Mecha§r: a 10 block suit of armour that walks, flies and fires lasers and missiles. See its chapter.

§a8. Portal to Oa§r: opens a portal to the planet Oa, home of the Corps. See the Oa and the Portal chapter.
guide.greenlantern.drill.title: Giant Drill
guide.greenlantern.drill:
The Giant Drill is a digging vehicle: you sit in a cockpit on tracks with a huge drill bit in front.

§aUsing it§r
Select the drill (construct 6) and right-click to summon it and climb in. Click again or sneak to get off.

§aDriving§r
• §eW§r moves where the bit points. The bit follows your aim.
• Looking ahead you drive and bore straight tunnels with a flat floor.
• Look down to dig shafts and up to bore through the ceiling.
• §eS§r reverses, §eA/D§r strafe, jump hops.
• Against rock the drill grips the walls, so you can stop halfway down a shaft. In open air it falls.

§aMining§r
The drill bores a tunnel big enough for itself and its rider and mines stone, dirt, sand, gravel and every kind of ore, including deepslate and Nether ores. Hard blocks like obsidian take longer. Bedrock is never broken. Mined items go straight to your inventory (whatever doesn't fit drops at your feet), and ores drop experience.

§aWeapon§r
The spinning bit hurts and pushes creatures that touch it.

§aTip§r
The drill drains energy every second: charge the ring before a long expedition and bring a Power Battery.
guide.greenlantern.mecha.title: Giant Mecha
guide.greenlantern.mecha:
The Giant Mecha is a 10 block tall suit of hard-light armour. You pilot it from the cockpit in its chest.

§aUsing it§r
Select the mecha (construct 7) and right-click: it builds itself around you, from the feet up. It needs open space for a 10 block giant. §eSneak§r to climb out, and it fades away.

§aWalking§r
• §eW/S§r walk, §eA/D§r sidestep.
• The torso turns to where you look and the legs follow slowly: the mecha is heavy.
• §eCtrl§r makes it run.
• It strides over steps up to 2 blocks high and bursts through treetops.

§aFlying§r
• Hold §ejump§r: the back thrusters spool up and the mecha lifts off.
• In the air, §eW§r flies where you look (look down to descend) and §eCtrl§r fires the afterburner.
• Release jump to hover, slowly sinking.
• A hard landing sends out a shockwave that throws nearby creatures.

§aWeapons§r
• §eHold right-click§r: the fist cannons fire twin lasers at the point you aim at. They hurt and set things on fire.
• §eLeft-click§r: a salvo of homing missiles leaves the shoulder pods and chases the creature you aim at (or the nearest enemy ahead). Reloads in 2 seconds.

§aProtection§r
Inside the cockpit you take no damage: the mecha absorbs hits, arrows and explosions with ring energy. You can't drown or burn either.

§aEnergy§r
The mecha drains energy every second, more while flying and firing the laser, and every missile salvo has a cost. If the ring runs dry, the mecha fades away.
guide.greenlantern.controls.title: Controls
guide.greenlantern.controls:
Keys can be changed in §eOptions → Controls → Key Binds → DC Universe§r.

§eRight-click§r (ring): put on the uniform or use the construct.
§eG§r: put on / remove the uniform.
§eR§r (hold): construct wheel.
§eR§r (tap): next construct.
§eShift + mouse wheel§r (ring in hand): switch construct.
§eDouble-tap jump§r: take off / stop flying.
§eW§r while flying: accelerate. §eCtrl§r: accelerate faster.
§eA A§r or §eD D§r flying fast: barrel roll.
§eS§r flying fast: air brake.
§eW A S D§r in vehicles: drive. §eJump§r: hop. §eSneak§r: get off.
§eIn the mecha§r: §eW A S D§r walk, §eJump§r (hold) fly, §eCtrl§r run / afterburner, §eRight-click§r (hold) laser, §eLeft-click§r missiles, §eSneak§r get out.
§eRight-click the Battery§r: charge the ring.

§6The Flash§r
§eSprint§r (suit on): start running.
§eR§r (hold / tap): power wheel / next power.
§eV§r: use the selected power.
§eShift + mouse wheel§r (Flash ring in hand): switch power.
guide.greenlantern.recipes.title: Recipes
guide.greenlantern.recipe.power_ring: A diamond on top and four emeralds forming the band. The ring comes out empty: charge it at a Power Battery before using it.
guide.greenlantern.recipe.power_battery: Iron ingots in the corners, lime stained glass on the sides, a lantern in the middle and an emerald block below.
guide.greenlantern.recipe.guide_book: A book and an emerald, in any position. Craft another manual if you lose yours.
guide.greenlantern.tips.title: Tips
guide.greenlantern.tips:
• In Creative mode, the §2DC Universe Heroes§r tab has rings that are already charged.

• Keep an eye on the energy bar. Vehicles (saw, drill and mecha) and the bubble drain energy all the time.

• Use the Giant Saw to gather wood and the Giant Drill to mine: both are great weapons too. To face a horde or a boss, call the Giant Mecha.

• The bubble reflects arrows and other projectiles.

• Supersonic flight costs up to 3 times more energy.

• Every number in the mod (energy, costs, damage, speeds, whether the drill mines or the saw cuts plants) can be tuned in §econfig/greenlantern-common.toml§r. Visual effects and the flight music are in §econfig/greenlantern-client.toml§r.

"In brightest day, in blackest night, no evil shall escape my sight!"

guide.greenlantern.oa.title: Oa and the Portal
guide.greenlantern.oa:
Oa is the home planet of the Green Lantern Corps, at the center of the universe. You get there with the Portal construct.

§aOpening the portal§r
Select the Portal (construct 8) and right-click: an oval of hard light opens three blocks in front of you. Walk through it to travel to Oa. The portal stays open for 20 seconds, so your friends can follow.

§aComing back§r
On Oa, use the Portal construct again: it opens the way back to exactly where you left.

§aThe city§r
• You arrive on a dais at the edge of the great plaza.
• In the middle stands the §2Central Power Battery§r, a giant lantern that shines a green beam into the sky. Stand near it and your ring recharges by itself.
• Around it, eight pillars hold the §bGuardians of the Universe§r. Fly up and right-click one to hear their wisdom: they also refill your ring.
• Lanterns of many species walk around the plaza and patrol the sky. Right-click them to chat.
• Spires of dark stone and quartz rise around the plaza, with rings of green light and crystals on the plains.

§aGood to know§r
• Oa has eternal night under a green starry sky and its own music.
• No monsters spawn on Oa, and you can't sleep there.
• The portal costs ring energy (portalCost in the config).

guide.greenlantern.flash.title: The Flash
guide.greenlantern.flash:
The DC Universe keeps growing: the first new hero is §cthe Flash§r, the fastest man alive.

§6The ring§r
Craft the §6Flash Ring§r (redstone, gold and a lightning rod). Like Barry Allen's, it stores the suit: right-click or press §eG§r to put it on (cowl, suit, leggings and boots). One hero at a time: putting on the Flash suit removes the Lantern uniform and vice versa.

§6Super speed§r
With the suit, §esprint§r to start running. Keep holding §eforward§r and the speed keeps building up: it breaks the sound barrier (with a boom) after a few seconds and keeps going. Hold §eback§r to skid to a stop and §esneak§r to slow down.

§6On water and up walls§r
Fast enough, you run over water. Run into a wall and you go straight up it: §ejump§r to kick off the wall, keep going to vault over the top.

§6Super jump§r
Jump while running: the faster you are, the higher and farther you go. Speedsters take no fall damage.

§6Speed Force§r
The powers use Speed Force (yellow bar). It recharges slowly while you wear the suit, and much faster while you run.
guide.greenlantern.flash_powers.title: Flash Powers
guide.greenlantern.flash_powers:
With the Flash suit, hold §eR§r for the power wheel (tap R for the next power) and press §eV§r (or right-click with the ring) to use the selected power.

§6Tornado§r
The Flash runs in circles and the air becomes a vortex: creatures around are pulled in, lifted, spun and hurt, and thrown out when it ends. While it lasts you run around it on your own; sneak or use the power again to stop. Costs Speed Force every second.

§6Molecular Vibration§r
Pass through walls, floors and attacks. You do not fall: hold §ejump§r to rise and §esneak§r to sink. It ends when you use it again, after 10 seconds or when the Speed Force runs out, and you are always pushed out to the nearest free spot: no suffocating in walls or falling through the world.

§6Speed Force Lightning§r
Throw a bolt of lightning that arcs to up to two more enemies nearby. Throw it while running fast and it hits much harder.
guide.greenlantern.recipe.flash_ring: Redstone in the corners, gold ingots on the sides and a lightning rod in the center. The ring starts without Speed Force: put on the suit and run to charge it.
